passages.text: Now Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense, and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to His command.
passages.sermon:
Aaron had two sons named Nadab and Abihu.
Nadab took his own censer.
Abihu took his own censer.
They put fire in their censers.
They placed incense on the fire.
They brought this fire before the LORD.
This fire was unauthorized.
The LORD had not commanded them to do this.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ אַ֠הֲרֹן נָדָ֨ב וַאֲבִיה֜וּא אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בָהֵן֙ אֵ֔שׁ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלֶ֖יהָ קְטֹ֑רֶת וַיַּקְרִ֜בוּ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣שׁ זָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֦א צִוָּ֖ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died in the presence of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
The LORD punishes disobedience.
Fire came out from the presence of the LORD.
The fire consumed Nadab and Abihu.
Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֥צֵא אֵ֛שׁ מִלִּפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַתֹּ֣אכַל אוֹתָ֑ם וַיָּמֻ֖תוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD meant when He said: ‘To those who come near Me I will show My holiness, and in the sight of all the people I will reveal My glory.’ ” But Aaron remained silent.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Moses said, “This is what the LORD said.”
The LORD said, “I will show My holiness to those who come near Me.”
The LORD said, “I will reveal My glory before all the people.”
Aaron stayed silent.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן הוּא֩ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה׀ לֵאמֹר֙ בִּקְרֹבַ֣י אֶקָּדֵ֔שׁ וְעַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אֶכָּבֵ֑ד וַיִּדֹּ֖ם אַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Come here; carry the bodies of your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary.”
passages.sermon:
Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan.
Mishael and Elzaphan were sons of Uzziel.
Uzziel was Aaron’s uncle.
Moses spoke to Mishael and Elzaphan.
He told them to come near.
He told them to carry the bodies of their cousins.
He told them to take the bodies away from the front of the sanctuary.
He told them to carry the bodies outside the camp.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־ מִֽישָׁאֵל֙ וְאֶ֣ל אֶלְצָפָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֻזִּיאֵ֖ל דֹּ֣ד אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם קִ֠רְב֞וּ שְׂא֤וּ אֶת־ אֲחֵיכֶם֙ מֵאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses had directed.
passages.sermon:
Mishael and Elzaphan were sons of Uzziel, who was Aaron’s uncle.
Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan.
Moses told them to carry the bodies of their cousins.
Mishael and Elzaphan came forward.
They carried the bodies in their tunics.
They took the bodies outside the camp.
They did this as Moses had directed.
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְב֗וּ וַיִּשָּׂאֻם֙ בְּכֻתֳּנֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, “Do not let your hair become disheveled and do not tear your garments, or else you will die, and the LORD will be angry with the whole congregation. But your brothers, the whole house of Israel, may mourn on account of the fire that the LORD has ignited.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Moses spoke to Eleazar and Ithamar.
Eleazar and Ithamar were Aaron’s sons.
Moses said, “Do not let your hair become disheveled.
Do not tear your garments.
If you do these things, you will die.
If you do these things, the LORD will be angry with the whole congregation.
Your brothers, the whole house of Israel, may mourn.
They may mourn because of the fire that the LORD has sent.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֡ן וּלְאֶלְעָזָר֩ וּלְאִֽיתָמָ֨ר׀ בָּנָ֜יו רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֥ם אַל־ תִּפְרָ֣עוּ׀ וּבִגְדֵיכֶ֤ם לֹֽא־ תִפְרֹ֙מוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א תָמֻ֔תוּ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה יִקְצֹ֑ף וַאֲחֵיכֶם֙ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִבְכּוּ֙ אֶת־ הַשְּׂרֵפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You shall not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, or you will die, for the LORD’s anointing oil is on you.” So they did as Moses instructed.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar.
Aaron and his sons were priests.
Moses said, “Do not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
If you go out, you will die.
The LORD’s anointing oil is on you.”
Aaron and his sons obeyed Moses.
They did as Moses instructed.
passages.original: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ פֶּן־ תָּמֻ֔תוּ כִּי־ שֶׁ֛מֶן מִשְׁחַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כִּדְבַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink when you enter the Tent of Meeting, or else you will die; this is a permanent statute for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Aaron.
The LORD gave Aaron a command.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron’s sons served as priests with him.
The LORD said, “Do not drink wine when you enter the Tent of Meeting.
Do not drink strong drink when you enter the Tent of Meeting.
Your sons must not drink wine or strong drink with you when you enter.
If you drink wine or strong drink in the Tent of Meeting, you will die.
This rule is permanent.
This rule applies to all your generations.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֞ר אַל־ תֵּ֣שְׁתְּ׀ אַתָּ֣ה׀ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֗ךְ בְּבֹאֲכֶ֛ם אֶל־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְלֹ֣א תָמֻ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the clean and the unclean, so that you may teach the Israelites all the statutes that the LORD has given them through Moses.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Aaron.
God gave Aaron and his sons a command.
Aaron and his sons must make clear distinctions.
They must separate what is holy from what is common.
They must separate what is clean from what is unclean.
Aaron and his sons must teach the Israelites.
They must teach all the laws God gave them.
God gave these laws to the Israelites through Moses.
passages.original: וּֽלֲהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑ל וּבֵ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבֵ֥ין הַטָּהֽוֹר׃ וּלְהוֹרֹ֖ת אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַ֣חֻקִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: And Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, “Take the grain offering that remains from the offerings made by fire to the LORD and eat it without leaven beside the altar, because it is most holy.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Moses spoke to Eleazar and Ithamar.
Eleazar and Ithamar were Aaron’s remaining sons.
Moses gave them a command.
He said, “Take the grain offering that is left from the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
Eat this grain offering without leaven.
Eat it beside the altar.
This grain offering is most holy.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְאֶ֣ל אֶ֠לְעָזָר וְאֶל־ אִ֨יתָמָ֥ר׀ בָּנָיו֮ הַנּֽוֹתָרִים֒ קְח֣וּ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה הַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מֵאִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְאִכְל֥וּהָ מַצּ֖וֹת אֵ֣צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃

passages.text: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the offerings made by fire to the LORD; for this is what I have been commanded.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons.
Aaron and his sons served as priests for Israel.
Moses said, “You must eat the grain offering in a holy place.
This offering comes from the sacrifices made by fire to the LORD.
This portion belongs to you and your sons.
The LORD gave this share to you and your sons.
I have received this command from the LORD.”
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתָהּ֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ כִּ֣י חָקְךָ֤ וְחָק־ בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ הִ֔וא מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כִּי־ כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי׃

passages.text: And you and your sons and daughters may eat the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution in a ceremonially clean place, because these portions have been assigned to you and your children from the peace offerings of the sons of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron had sons and daughters.
Moses also spoke to Eleazar and Ithamar.
Eleazar and Ithamar were Aaron’s remaining sons.
Moses gave them instructions about offerings.
You must eat the breast of the wave offering.
You must also eat the thigh of the contribution.
Eat these in a place that is ceremonially clean.
You, your sons, and your daughters may eat them.
These portions belong to you and your children.
The sons of Israel gave these as peace offerings.
God assigned these portions to you and your family.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ חֲזֵ֨ה הַתְּנוּפָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם טָה֔וֹר אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֥יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ אִתָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ חָקְךָ֤ וְחָק־ בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ נִתְּנ֔וּ מִזִּבְחֵ֥י שַׁלְמֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: They are to bring the thigh of the contribution and the breast of the wave offering, together with the fat portions of the offerings made by fire, to wave as a wave offering before the LORD. It will belong permanently to you and your children, as the LORD has commanded.”
passages.sermon:
The priests must bring the thigh of the contribution.
They must also bring the breast of the wave offering.
They must bring these parts with the fat portions from the offerings made by fire.
They must wave these parts as a wave offering before the LORD.
The thigh and the breast will belong to you, Aaron, and to your children.
This is a permanent rule for you and your descendants.
The LORD has commanded this.
passages.original: שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֞ה וַחֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה עַ֣ל אִשֵּׁ֤י הַחֲלָבִים֙ יָבִ֔יאוּ לְהָנִ֥יף תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֨ה לְךָ֜ וּלְבָנֶ֤יךָ אִתְּךָ֙ לְחָק־ עוֹלָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Later, Moses searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned up. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons, and asked, “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the holy place? For it is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the congregation by making atonement for them before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering.
He saw that the goat had been burned up.
Eleazar and Ithamar were Aaron’s remaining sons.
Moses became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar.
He asked them a question.
He said, “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the holy place?”
The sin offering is most holy.
God gave the sin offering to you.
You were to take away the guilt of the congregation with it.
You were to make atonement for the people before the LORD.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽחַטָּ֗את דָּרֹ֥שׁ דָּרַ֛שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֹׂרָ֑ף וַ֠יִּקְצֹף עַל־ אֶלְעָזָ֤ר וְעַל־ אִֽיתָמָר֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ מַדּ֗וּעַ לֹֽא־ אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִ֑וא וְאֹתָ֣הּ׀ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם לָשֵׂאת֙ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן הָעֵדָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Since its blood was not brought inside the holy place, you should have eaten it in the sanctuary area, as I commanded.”
passages.sermon: The blood of the sin offering was not brought into the inner sanctuary.\r\nYou should have eaten the offering in the holy place.\r\nI commanded you to do this.
passages.original: הֵ֚ן לֹא־ הוּבָ֣א אֶת־ דָּמָ֔הּ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ פְּנִ֑ימָה אָכ֨וֹל תֹּאכְל֥וּ אֹתָ֛הּ בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוֵּֽיתִי׃

passages.text: But Aaron replied to Moses, “Behold, this very day they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD. Since these things have happened to me, if I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been acceptable in the sight of the LORD?”
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron spoke to Moses.
Aaron said, “Today the people brought their sin offering before the LORD.
Today the people also brought their burnt offering before the LORD.
Troubles have happened to me today.
If I had eaten the sin offering today, would the LORD have been pleased?
Would it have been good in the LORD’s eyes if I ate it today?”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן הַ֠יּוֹם הִקְרִ֨יבוּ אֶת־ חַטָּאתָ֤ם וְאֶת־ עֹֽלָתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּקְרֶ֥אנָה אֹתִ֖י כָּאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָכַ֤לְתִּי חַטָּאת֙ הַיּ֔וֹם הַיִּיטַ֖ב בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And when Moses heard this explanation, he was satisfied.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Aaron was his brother and the high priest.
Aaron explained his actions to Moses.
Moses listened to Aaron’s explanation.
Moses accepted Aaron’s explanation.
Moses was satisfied.
